title: Lisa Larson-Torres
description: Refused to implement Gov. Youngkin’s model policies prohibiting boys in girls’ bathrooms and locker rooms and from keeping gender identity secrets from parents.
body:
# Lisa Larson-Torres

# School Board Chair

![](/media/uploads/2026/02/torres-profile.png)

- **[Said](https://web.archive.org/web/20240915161415/https:/www.cvilletomorrow.org/lisa-larson-torres-wants-to-continue-equity-work-in-second-term-on-charlottesville-city-school-board/)** equity is her top priority
- **[Supported a policy](https://web.archive.org/web/20240915161415/https:/www.cvilletomorrow.org/lisa-larson-torres-wants-to-continue-equity-work-in-second-term-on-charlottesville-city-school-board/)** that prohibits students from wearing clothing that depicts “confederate imagery.”
- In March 2025, **[voted against](https://web.archive.org/web/20251008030516/https:/www.29news.com/2025/03/28/armed-resource-officers-likely-returning-charlottesville-schools/)** returning police/school resource officers back to schools.
- **[Refused](https://web.archive.org/web/20260323122827/https:/www.29news.com/2022/10/07/ccs-pushes-back-harder-against-youngkin-model-policies/)** to implement Gov. Youngkin’s model policies prohibiting boys in girls’ bathrooms and locker rooms and from keeping gender identity secrets from parents.
